messages:
Maya Shah: Heads up — seeing a cluster of tiny gang jobs stuck Pending in ap-southeast1. Events show 'Lease expired' and scheduler logs complaining about 'orphaned-gpu-satellites'.
Chris L: Which pool/instance family? any node-level taints?
Maya Shah: It's mixed N-type racks, mostly g4dn-equivalents. PodAffinity is strict (gang scheduling). Example event from one pod: 
```
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  Failed     2m    scheduler          lease expired for gpu-lease-1234
  Normal   Scheduled  2m    kubelet, node-12   Successfully assigned ...
```
Raj Patel: Hm. "orphaned-gpu-satellites" suggests the lease-controller didn't renew node-side heartbeats. Any network egress errors around the nodes? I saw conntrack nearing limits in ap-southeast last week.
Infra Oncall: Confirmed elevated SNAT reuse on that AZ ~10:10 UTC. Ops telemetry shows ephemeral port exhaustion on the NAT gateway for a subset of racks.
Chris L: If lease renewals fail intermittently, scheduler marks satellites missing and then gang pods can't get full set of GPUs -> Pending. Could also be kubelet time drift causing short-circuit TTL. Can you paste `kubectl get pods -o wide` for a sample job?
Maya Shah: Pasted a short list and `kubectl describe` earlier. Node 12/13 show kubelet last heartbeat 3m ago even though node is up. Time skew on node-13 is ~2m fast.
Raj Patel: Time skew + SNAT exhaustion = race. Lease renew interval is 30s with TTL 90s; if renews dropped, controller thinks satellite gone and taints out the allocation. Workaround: temporarily bump TTL / reduce renew interval or extend requeue backoff.
Infra Oncall: Short-term mitigation: cordon the nodes with the highest SNAT usage and move new gang pods to other racks. We're also restarting the lease-agent daemonset on the affected nodes now.
deploy-bot: Rolling restart of lease-agent daemonset initiated by @Infra Oncall (ds/lease-agent)
Chris L: Also add a scheduler fallback policy to allow soft-affinity on retry window to avoid full gang starvation during transient network issues. Not a long-term fix but reduces user impact.
Maya Shah: After restarting lease-agent on node-12/13, controller re-registered satellites. I see 38/42 pods rescheduled and starting token fetch for GPUs. Still watching.
Raj Patel: Please file an incident with NAT metrics + conntrack counts. Action items: (1) increase NAT capacity for ap-southeast1 racks, (2) add lease renew jitter and lower interval for flaky networks, (3) audit node NTP config and enforce chrony via kubeadm hook, (4) add scheduler retry soft-affinity TTL.
Infra Oncall: Filing incident now. Will also post a follow-up with timeline and rollout plan for NAT bump.
Maya Shah: Thanks all — will monitor and post a short postmortem once we confirm stabilisation. :thumbsup:
